{{short description|American mathematician}}
'''Michael Somos''' is an American [[mathematician]], who was a visiting scholar in the [[Georgetown University]] Mathematics and Statistics department for four years and is a visiting scholar at The [[Catholic University of America]]. In the late eighties he proposed a conjecture about certain [[polynomial recurrence]]s, now called [[Somos sequence]]s,<ref>{{cite web|url=http://faculty.uml.edu/jpropp/somos.html|title=The Somos Sequence Site |publisher= [[University of Massachusetts Lowell]]|author =[[Jim Propp]]|date=2006-08-08 |accessdate=2009-10-13}}</ref> that surprisingly in some cases contain only integers. [[Somos' quadratic recurrence constant]] is also named after him.
